# files_shared_workflow (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "files_shared_workflow" "example_shared_workflow" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Shared Workflow ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description displayed to recipients.
- `form_fields` (Dynamic) Current custom questions in display order.
- `name` (String) Name displayed to recipients.
- `submission_revision` (String) Revision required when submitting a Shared Workflow run.
